verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API. Its closest match to a background automation is price-tracking subscriptions, which send webhook notifications whenever a product's price changes (channel3-docs-16). Users can also script calls through the CLI (channel3-docs-13), but scheduling and orchestration would have to come from external tools. There is no general-purpose way to define autonomous background workflows. Missing for 10: a configurable automation or scheduled-job feature, triggers beyond price changes, docs on running agentic tasks unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the webhook monitoring.
